answers.explanation: Root hairs grow out of the epidermal cells of the root, which absorb water and mineral salts.
The pericycle, the layer just inside the endodermis, gives rise to lateral roots.
Guard cells contain chloroplasts, which other epidermal cells lack, so they can photosynthesise and open the stomata.
Herbs do not become woody, while shrubs develop woody stems.
The cell takes in water by osmosis from distilled water and becomes turgid.
A hydrogen to oxygen ratio of 2:1 is characteristic of carbohydrates.
Magnesium is a part of the chlorophyll molecule and iron is needed for its formation.
Mammalian red blood cells lose their nuclei when they mature, so the statement that they have nuclei is not true.
Medullary rays carry gases and water vapour across the stem of a woody plant.
Calcium chloride is not normally excreted in urine, while water, sodium chloride and nitrogenous compounds are.
Kidneys regulate osmotic processes by controlling the water and salt content of the blood.
A nastic movement is a response to a stimulus that has no particular direction.
The cerebellum coordinates movement and maintains balance.
New bulbs arise from the axillary bud, which is labelled 3 in the section of the onion bulb.

An aggregate fruit develops from a single flower with several free carpels.
The organic matter lost on burning is 28 - 18 = 10 g, which is 10/28 = 35.7 percent of the soil sample.
Maize rust is caused by a fungus, not a virus.
Centipedes have poison claws, which millipedes do not have.
An organism with two identical genes for a trait is a homozygote.

Banana, plantain and pineapple produce suckers, which is how they are propagated.
Malaria is caused by a protozoan parasite, not directly by bacteria.

Starting from the skull, the vertebrae are atlas, axis, cervical, thoracic and lumbar.

Self-pollinating the F1 tall heterozygotes gives a 3 tall : 1 short ratio in F2.
Glucose from the ileum goes through the hepatic portal vein to the liver, then the hepatic vein, vena cava and heart.
